run.answer:
## Household review complete

- **CloudBox:** The $99.99 annual plan charge posted Oct. 1 after the trial ended. I submitted refund request **CB-1002** and scheduled a follow-up for Oct. 23. The notice’s 14-day refund window appears to have ended Oct. 15. Cancellation needs your approval; I saved a waiting case.
- **FitHub:** Charges of $34.99 continued monthly through Oct. 15 despite your note that you haven’t visited since April. I submitted billing inquiry **FH-1003** about credits for the Sep. 15 and Oct. 15 charges and scheduled a follow-up. Cancellation needs your approval; I saved a waiting case.
- **StreamFlix:** The increase from $13.99 to $18.99 began with the August bill as notified. I requested loyalty pricing in ticket **SF-1001** and scheduled a follow-up.
- **ShopMart:** The promised $42.24 return refund posted Sep. 5; no further request was needed.
- I reviewed the recurring charges for **Spotify, Oakview Apartments, and Metro Power**. I found no billing issue or note indicating you want a change.

The review records are saved, and the final completeness check reports no remaining review items.

verify_run.answer:

- **CloudBox:** The $99.99 annual charge posted Oct 1, and a matching $99.99 credit posted Oct 15. I recorded the credit as received; refund case CB-1002 was already submitted. **Your approval is needed to cancel the plan.**
- **StreamFlix:** The monthly charge rose from $13.99 to $18.99. Its $15 loyalty credit posted Oct 15, and I recorded it as received. The pricing request was already submitted.
- **FitHub:** Your note says you haven’t attended since moving in April. I found $34.99 charges on Sep 15 and Oct 15. A refund review for those two charges was submitted as FH-1003. **Your approval is needed to cancel the $34.99 monthly membership.**
- I found no fee, duplicate-charge or expected-credit leads requiring a new request. Existing open recurring-charge items were preserved.

Follow-ups are scheduled for the company responses. The remaining user actions are approving or declining cancellation of CloudBox and FitHub.

fields.message: I received notice on July 10 that the Premium price would increase from $13.99 to $18.99/month starting with the August bill. The $18.99 charges posted on Aug 12, Sep 12, and Oct 12, 2026. Please review my account for available long-time member loyalty pricing and let me know the monthly rate you can offer.

I was charged $99.99 for CloudBox Plus annual plan on October 1, 2026 after the free trial ending September 30. I signed up only to move photos and do not need the service. Please refund this unwanted trial conversion charge under the annual plan refund policy. I understand the stated 14-day window may have just passed; please review for an exception.

I moved across town in April 2026 and have not used the gym since. My membership remains active and I was charged $34.99 on Sep 15 and Oct 15, 2026. Please review whether these unused membership charges can be refunded or credited, and advise on the process to end the membership. I am not authorizing cancellation through this message.
